notes.title: Dreamgate Update #12 - New cards, Heroes and more
notes.content:
Hi! There has been no news from us for a long time ... and our team would like to apologize for that.
The past year was quite difficult for ours due to the COVID epidemic.
This situation changed our plans and slowed down the game development process a lot.

But we continue to add features to our game and are getting closer to the release of our game.
In this patch, we added: 50 Cunning cards, 4 new heroes and fixed some bugs

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #11 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi!
There has been no news for a long time, but don't worry, we are continuing to work on the game.
Unfortunately, the situation with covid-19 significantly slowed down our work (((

In this patch, we have fixed a few bugs (including graphical bug on Nvidia GPU)

Bug fixed:

Fixed graphical bug on Nvidia GPU. If you still have graphical bugs, we would be grateful if you could tell us about it. There are only 2 people in our team and it is very difficult for us to test the game on various PC configurations.
Fixed various bugs with anomalies
Fixed a bug when some items (loot cards) dropped out to players very rarely or did not drop at all.
Fixed various bugs with cards when they did not work correctly

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #10 - Balance Changes
notes.content:
Hi!
We continue to improve our game. Based on the collected statistics and your feedback, we made a rebalance for cards and passive skills

Gameplay Changes

Drop chance for gold cards is slightly increased. 
Some encounters have been slightly changed.
Now you get More gold after defeating Doomlord.



Balance Changes
Skills 

Battle Rage buff: Discard a card: if you discard a Spell, deal 1 damage to ALL enemies 3 times -> Discard a card: if you discard a Spell, deal 1 damage to ALL enemies 4 times.


Passive Skills

Fighter buff: damage increased from 7 to 9.
Demonic Armor buff: Gain +7 Max HP -> Gain +9 Max HP.
Dark Power buff: Damage from all your cards is increased by 1 -> Damage from all your cards is increased by 2.
Iron Will buff: If your deck contains 60+ cards, draw an additional card per turn -> If your deck contains 50+ cards, draw an additional card per turn.
Gladiator changed: Weapon cards deal 1 more damage.
Mage changed: Spell cards deal 1 more damage.
Mark of the Void buff: Gain +8 Max HP. Exile 5 random cards. -> Gain +8 Max HP. Exile 3 random cards.

Weapon

Spiked Club buff: damage increased from 1 -4 to 1-5.
Increased damage for all upgraded weapons.


Items

Bomb buff: damage increased from 1 to 2.

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #9 - New levels for Hard Mode and Balance Changes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We continue to work on the game and in this patch we made some balance changes and added 8 new levels for the “Hard mode”.
We also started working on a "Cunning skills" - there will be 40 new cards and several new heroes who will use these cards

Gameplay
8 new levels for Hard Mode, for those who want more challenge.
The amount of experience required to receive rewards has been reduced.

Balance changes
Furious Charge buffed: Lose -3 HP -> Lose -2 HP.
B.F. Axe changed: Deal 3 damage. If you have 40 or more cards in your deck deal 16 damage instead -> Deal 4 damage. If you have 50 or more cards in your deck deal 18 damage instead.
Doomlord slightly changed 
Savage (passive skill) buffed: Gain +10 Max HP -> Gain +15 Max HP.
Hunter (passive skill) buffed: Lose -5 Max HP -> Lose -4 Max HP.
Perseverance (passive skill) nerfed: Lose -3 Max HP  -> Lose -7 Max HP. This passive skill for Warlock was too strong especially compared to Hunter
Slayer (passive skill) buffed: Deal +2 damage to bosses -> Deal +3 damage to bosses.


LocalizationAdded Chinese (Simplified)

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #8 - New "Game Progress System", Hero and Cards
notes.content:
Hi all!
It's time for a new big patch! In this patch we add to the game - New game progression system, new hero and 15+ new cards

New systemsGame progression system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766264/ed97f5a5b1668e93108ca01a349ea46611cb8d65.png
Game statistics

New HeroBloodmage

New Cards (Items)Demon's Horn - Exile a card from your draw pile.
Thief's Hood - Reserve. Charge 1. Escape from a non-boss encounter. Receive no loot.
Cultist Wand - Limited. Draw 3 cards. Add a Curse on top of the draw pile.
Belt- Limited. Draw 2 random cards from discard pile. If you have 30 or more cards in your discard pile, draw 3 random cards from discard pile instead.
Dynamite- Limited. Charge 1. Deal 12 damage.
Cursed Locket - Unplayable. Gold 200. At the start of your turn discard a non-Curse card.
The Silent Killer - Reserve. Destroy a non-Boss enemy. You can use this card only if one enemy in the encounter.

New Cards (Bloodmage)Fireworks - Deal 2 damage. If you have 10 or more Fire cards in your deck deal 8 damage instead.
Magic Bomb - Energy 1. Deal 3 damage for each Magic Bomb in your deck.
Fire Club - Energy 1. Fire. Deal 1 damage 5 times.
Wrath - Energy 3. Deal 17 damage. If you have 25 or less cards in your deck deal 6 damage to all enemies instead.
Rebirth - Reduce your maximum HP by 2. Restore to full HP.
Spirit of Fire - Energy 2. Draw 4 random Fire cards from your draw pile.
Vengeance - Deal X damage, where X is the number of missing HP. Lose -1 HP.
Fire Nova - Energy 4. Fire. Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Deal 3 damage to all enemies.
Ash Ritual - Exile Fire card from your hand and restore 5 HP.
Renegade - Charge 1. Exile all Fire cards from your deck. Increase your max HP by 8.

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #7 - Balance Changes and New Passive Skills
notes.content:
Hi all,

Balance ChangesMighty Strike buffed: bonus damage increased from 4 ->5
Net buffed: Limited. Reduce the attack of all enemies by 1. -> Limited. Reduce the attack of all enemies by 1. Draw a card.
War Hammer buffed: damage increased by 1.
Whirlwind slightly reworked: Deal 5 damage to ALL (including your hero). Rage: Deal damage only to all enemies. 
Cursed Touch buffed  - Deal 1-4 damage. If you have a Curse in your HAND, deal 8 damage instead - > Deal 1-4 damage. If you have a Curse in your DECK, deal 8 damage instead.
Malice buffed: damage increased from 3 -> 4

New Passive SkillsThug - You can play 2 additional Limited cards each turn. At the beginning of your turn, discard a card.
Nimble - You can play additional Limited card each turn.
Arcane Blood - If you do not have Energy then you spend your HP.

Bug FixFixed bug with a Phantom Sentinel
 Fixed visual bug with cards backlit 
Fixed Russian localization

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #6 - 3 New Heroes and 40+ New Cards
notes.content:
Hi
It's time for a big patch! In this patch we add to the game - 3 new heroes and more than 40 new cards.

New Heroes:
- Elementalist (Arcane)
- Battle Mage (Arcane and War)
- Voidbringer (Arcane and Dark)

New Mechanics
- Energy X (Arcane cards only) - In order to play this card, you must spend X Energy. 

New Cards (Arcane):Fireball - Fire. Energy 1. Deal 6 damage.
Elemental Blow - Deal 1 damage. Upgrade all Elemental Blow cards in your deck.
Fire Mark - Fire. Energy 2. Choose an enemy and deal 8 damage to adjacent ones.
Magic Trick - Deal 4 damage.
Thunder Strike - Lightning. Energy 1. Deal 4-11 damage to a random enemy.
Energy Leech - Deal 3 damage, gain 1 Energy and draw a card. You can use this card only on stunned enemies.
Shock - Lightning. Reserve. Unplayable. At the end of your turn deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
Enchanted Weapon - Fire. Energy 1. This turn, your next Weapon deals +7 damage.
Fire Breath - Fire. Reserve. Energy 3. Deal 4 damage to all enemies.
Wisdom of the Elements - Reserve. Unplayable. At the start of your turn, draw an additional card and discard a card from hand.
Meteor - Fire. Energy 4. Deal 36 damage.
Arcane Power - Gain 1 Energy.
Arcane Intellect - Energy 2. Draw 3 cards.
Frost Arrow - Ice. Energy 1. Stun a non-Boss enemy and deal 1 damage to adjacent ones. Draw a random Ice card from your draw pile.
Frost Breath - Ice. Energy 3. Stun all non-Boss enemies.
Stone Armour - Earth. Energy 2. Gain a Shield.
Elemental Arrows - Fire. Lightning. Ice. Earth. Energy 1. Deal 1 damage 3 times.
Ice and Lightning - Ice. Deal 2 damage. If you have a Lightning card in your hand deal 5 damage instead.
Manastorm - Limited. Gain 3 Energy. Lose -1 HP.
Inner Power - Draw a card. If you have 6 or more energy, draw 4 cards instead and you cannot draw additional cards this turn.
Elemental Equilibrium - Limited. Energy 1. Draw a random Fire, Earth, Ice and Lightning card from your  draw pile.
Hailstorm - Ice. Energy 2. Deal 2 damage 7 times to random enemies.
Amplification - Fumble 1. This turn, your next Spell deals triple damage.
Eruption - Earth. Energy 1. Deal 1 damage to all enemies. If you have a Fire card in your hand deal 3 damage instead.
Magical Gifts - Energy 3. Charge 1. Choose a Passive card.
Spellslinger - Deal 10 damage. You can use this card only if you have a Wand in your deck
Wind Strike - Deal 6 damage. Put a card from your hand on top of the draw pile.
Spark - Lightning. Energy 1. Deal 3 damage. If you have 10 or more cards in your hand deal 10 
damage instead.
Chain Lightning - Lightning. Energy 1. Deal 2 damage. Then deal 3 damage to a random enemy, then deal 4 damage to a random enemy.
Thirst of Knowledge - Energy 1. Charge 1. Delve 3 Arcane common cards. Lose -1 Max HP. 
Twister - Energy 1. If you have 4 or more cards with Reserve in your hand, deal 6 damage to all 
enemies.
Ice Cage - Ice. Energy 2. Stun an enemy.
Rockfall - Earth. Energy 2. Deal 12 damage. If you have another Earth card in your hand deal 24 damage instead.
Path of Darkness - Energy 2. Charge 1. Delve 3 Dark rare cards.
Overload - Reserve. Unplayable. All your Spell deals double damage. Play no more than 3 cards per turn.
Mirror Image- Charge 1. Choose a non-Legendary card from your hand and add 2 copies of it to the draw pile.
Burning Aura - Fire. Reserve. Unplayable. At the start of your turn deal 1 damage to all enemies.
Dragon Wisdom - Limited. Draw 3 random Spells from your draw pile. Gain 1 Energy.
Firestorm - Fire. Energy 3. Deal 6 damage 3 times to random enemies. If you have an Earth card in your hand, gain 3 Energy.
Clarity - Reserve. Unplayable. At the start of your turn gain 1 Energy.
Ice Block - Ice. Reserve. Unplayable. At the end of your turn gain a Shield. Play no more than 3 cards per turn.
Shatter - Ice. Energy 2. Destroy a non-Boss enemy. If a target is stunned deal 3 damage to all 
enemies.
Inspiration - Limited. Draw 6 cards. Discard all Spell cards from your hand.
Earthquake - Earth. Energy 3. Stun all enemies with 2 or less attack. Deal 3 damage to all enemies 
with 3 or more attack.


New Cards (Item):
- Arcane Wand - Deal 3 damage. If you have 25 or less cards in your deck deal 6 damage instead.

Some UI Improvements

Various bugs fixed

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #5 - New Library and Treasure Chest
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
It's time for the next patch, which improves some aspects of our game.
A little spoilers: at the moment we are working on a large patch that will add 40 new cards (Arcane) and 3 new heroes to the game...stay tuned

FeaturesNew library - in which you can see all cards that are in the game. 
At the beginning, all the cards are closed, but as soon as you first see them, they will be added to the Library.

Fixed bug with Copycat and Greed.
Fixed bug with Talisman and Greed.
Fixed bug when you could not play cards from your hands
Talisman ability now "draw 2 random spells" instead of 2 random cards.

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #3 - New game mode, Russian localization and more
notes.content:
Hi!
It's time for the next patch, in which we added:
New FeaturesAnomalies mode - new game mode. In this mode you will need to select 1 anomaly from 3 and its effect will continue throughout the game. Therefore, it will be possible to select up to 3 different anomalies.
In addition to this, anomalies may appear in some battles and they will slightly change the game rules.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766264/69252c4f4d03773c5d7e06d137086eb2acd47c10.png

New ContentBow (weapon) - Limited. Deal 3 damage. Draw a card.
Champion 4/8 - Shield. Revenge: All enemies gain +1 Attack and Health.
Special loot from Champion:The Executioner - Destroy a non-Boss enemy with 4 or less Attack.
Tower Shield - If there are 3 or more enemies get a Shield.

Balance ChangesGargoyle: Tough removed, attack increased from 5 -> 6.
Spiked Club buff: max damage increased by 1.
Anger now Skill instead Spell.
Vengeance now Spell insted Skill.
Vengeance renamed to Blood Magic.


LocalizationAdded Russian localization
Fixed some English text


Bug FixFixed bug with Veteran passive skill when this skill did not give additional HP.
Fixed bug with game over window,  when you lost due to HP loss.
Fixed bug with Regen, when the creature’s HP was not fully restored, if it was increased.
Fixed bug with Magic Book and cards with double type
Fixed bug with Sorcerer passive skill, when the number of tokens could be more than 10.

notes.title: Dreamgate Update #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
it's time for the first big update for our game.

New FeaturesGame Map - now you will see all the encounters that will be on the level and you can plan your adventure from start to finish

New ContentBury (Dark Common) - Deal 2 damage. Discard 4 cards from top of the draw pile.
The Stars Are Right (Dark Rare) - Limited. Deal 1-11 damage. If you have 3+ copies of this card in your deck, deal 14 damage to all enemies instead.
Magic Book (Item) - Charge 1. Choose a Spell card in your hand and gain a copy of it to your hand.
Animated Armor- New boss for level 3.


Balance ChangesUnbreakable buff: now exile all Wounds, Curses and Poisons.
Duel buff: Rage: Draw a card -> Draw 2 cards.
Seismic Strike buff:For every 10 cards in the deck, deal 1 damage -> For every 10 cards in the deck, deal 2 damage.
Furious Charge buff: damage increased from 12 -> 14
Bloodlust rarity changed from Rare -> Legendary
Seismic Strike rarity changed from Legendary -> Rare
Soul Fire rarity changed from Common -> Rare
Dark Ritual rarity changed from Rare -> Legendary
Hellfire nerf: damage reduced from 4 -> 3
Removed 1 Devourer from hard encounter on level 2.
Doomlord difficulty slightly increased
Level 3 bosses difficulty slightly increased

LocalizationImproved localization for English text. Thanks to KingJoshington for helping with the proofreading of the English text.
Some keywords have been changed:Fatigue X-> Fumble X
Regeneration -> Regen
Endurance ->Tough
Last Breath -> Revenge
Usage X-> Charge X
Choose One - > Choose
Retrace - > Echo
Rampage -> Rage

Bug fixFixed bug with character screen selection
Fixed bug with passive skill King and Blacksmith
Fixed bug with passive skill Berserk
Berserk and Flex now work properly


We also want to thank all those of you who actively helped us (reported bugs and made suggestions for improving the game)
Dreamgate Discord: https://discord.gg/nPnj9zE - join to our community.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hi!
This is the first “Dev Diary” and we are plan to release it every 2 weeks to inform you about the development of the game and our plans.
This week, we released a patch that fixed a large number of bugs in our game + we released several “hot fixes”. At the same time, we continue to work on the quality of our game. I also want to thank all the players who reported bugs (our Discord: https://discord.gg/nPnj9zE - join to our community).
As for the changes and improvements that we are currently working on and which you can already see in the next patch (at the end of next week):
Game Map - now you will see all the encounters that will be on the level and you can plan your adventure from start to finish. Map screenshot (work in progress)

notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Also remind about our Discord: https://discord.gg/nPnj9zE (join to our community).

Fixed bug with Void Legacy.

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings. This is our roadmap - a list of things we plan to work on during Early Access.
It may change based on players feedback.


NEW CONTENT
40 Arcane cards (in addition to War and Dark cards)
3 new heroes:

    Arcanist (uses Arcane cards)
    Battle Mage (uses Arcane and War cards)
    Necromancer (uses Arcane and Dark cards)

More content: new encounters, enemies, items and passive skills

GAMEPLAY
Hard mode - for those players who like real challenges
Anomalies which can be turned on or off. Anomalies add additional random rules affecting the game.
"Сampaign mode" - end-game content. The game and/or characters change over time in a way that the results of one game may influence future plays. 
Features that will improve gameplay (based on players feedback)
Balance fixes

SYSTEM AND OTHER FEATURES
Localization to other languages (hope for community help)
UI Improvement
Controller Support
Hotkeys
Steam Trading Cards
